def transform(grid):
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    r1=max(r for r,c in cells)+1; c1=max(c for r,c in cells)+1
    h=(r1-r0)//2; w=(c1-c0)//2
    return [row[c0:c0+w] for row in grid[r0:r0+h]]
